content.text:
This figure is from AC 43.13-2B, Acceptable Methods, Techniques, and Practices: Aircraft Alterations. Its caption: "FIGURE 2-7. TYPICAL UNDERSEAT INSTALLATION".
Describe it for a mechanic who can't see it: say what it shows, then transcribe every label,
value, unit, part number, and note printed in it. Don't add anything that isn't in the figure.
If it shows nothing of use (a logo, a signature, a blank area), say so in one sentence.

message.content:
The figure shows a typical underseat installation with two views: a side view of a seat mounted above a floor, and a close-up detail of a floor attachment.

Labels, values, units, part numbers, and notes:

- 1" clearance with seat occupied and subject to maximum seat spring deflection (6.6 X 170 pounds) downward (load).
- Floor
- Plywood floor
- Unit attachment ear
- AN 970 flat washer
- Machine screw and elastic stop nut
